## Featured Projects

- [Agent Stream Doctor](https://mhkaman.com/en/projects/agent-stream-doctor/): Open-source Python toolkit diagnosing broken LLM streams: empty responses, reasoning-only replies, missing finish_reason, malformed SSE, truncated tool calls. Zero dependencies. [Source](https://github.com/Mohammad-Hasan-Kaman/agent-stream-doctor)
- [Kaman AI Translator](https://mhkaman.com/en/projects/kaman-ai-translator/): Desktop app translating PDF & EPUB books from English to academic Persian using Google Gemini. PyQt6.
- [Kaman Messenger](https://mhkaman.com/en/projects/kaman-messenger/): Real-time encrypted desktop messenger in pure Python: TCP sockets, AES (Fernet), bcrypt, rate limiting, SQLite. CustomTkinter GUI.
- [Dr-Kaman Site](https://mhkaman.com/en/projects/dr-kaman-site/): Production multimedia archive (audio, video, books, articles) serving drkaman.ir. Django + nginx + gunicorn.
- [Planikaa Portal](https://mhkaman.com/en/projects/planikaa-portal/): Django educational platform with exam analytics dashboard, blog, and student resources.

## Articles

- [Why is my LLM stream empty? A field guide to broken SSE responses](https://mhkaman.com/en/articles/why-is-my-llm-stream-empty/): Practical guide to diagnosing empty LLM responses, reasoning-only streams, and missing finish_reason in OpenAI-compatible APIs.
